result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answer no up front and give a light plan that fits a day or two, built on tokens, a few components, PR review and no versioning. A is tighter and gives more signals for doing more later: the second site starting, more components and a bigger team. B adds an unsupported claim that the full setup suits 'teams of 10 or more', adds Figma work and is longer. It also names only one signal, the second site. Neither answer says much about what staying light costs. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both say no up front and give a light plan that fits a day or two, with no review board, versioning or docs site. B names more signals for doing more later (the second site starting, component count, team growth), uses drift as the reason for keeping a small shared set of design decisions, and adds clear rules like no hardcoded values. A gives a made-up '10 or more' team-size cutoff and adds a Figma-mirroring step that makes its plan heavier.
